requirements.requirement: The system must render a 'clean' malpractice state when backend status=clean in end-to-end tests.
The system must render a 'flagged' malpractice state when backend status=flagged in end-to-end tests.
The system must render an 'unknown' malpractice state when backend status is null or missing.
The system must display a valid state_board_url link when provided by backend data.
The system must not render a clickable link when state_board_url is null or invalid.
The system must render score_contribution exactly as provided by backend without alteration in value.
The system must display score_contribution in a human-readable formatted form (e.g. percentage or points) consistent with UI standards.
The system must include the malpractice section in the provider scorecard UI when malpractice data is present.
The system must omit or gracefully collapse the malpractice section when all malpractice fields are missing.
The system must match UI snapshot tests for clean state rendering without visual regression.
The system must match UI snapshot tests for flagged state rendering without visual regression.
The system must not render any prohibited terms including 'fraud' in any malpractice UI state.
The system must not render any prohibited terms including 'misconduct' in any malpractice UI state.
The system must enforce neutral language phrasing in malpractice descriptions in all rendered outputs.
The system must ensure LLM-generated or templated text describing malpractice uses signal-based wording (e.g. 'history indicates') rather than accusatory language.
The system must reject or sanitize any LLM-generated text containing banned terms before rendering.
The system must produce consistent wording for identical malpractice inputs across multiple test runs.
The system must ensure LLM or templated outputs do not imply legal judgment or guilt.
The system must validate that rendering pipeline (MessageBubble.tsx) safely displays malpractice content without markdown injection.
The system must handle malformed backend malpractice payloads without UI crash and render fallback state.
